|game_text=Adds 3 to the power of anything he pilots. When deployed, may deploy from Reserve Deck (or lose 1 Force to deploy from Lost Pile) a blaster on [[Luke (V){{!}}Luke]]; reshuffle. |errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 4). The image here, the release-sheet slip, prints it. The PC website card list changed it (PC-E1, [[Luke Skywalker, Rebel Hero (Errata)]]); the Players Committee card image (PC-E2, [[Luke Skywalker, Rebel Hero (Errata 2)]]) and then the Master List of 2013 (PC-E3, [[Luke Skywalker, Rebel Hero (Errata 3)]], the current text) printed these words again.
* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet, official text as of 3 June 2011 (slip 01)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 3 June 2011"; copy re-made 25 July 2011, first printing not found), page 5, slip 26 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Adds 3 to the power of anything he pilots. When deployed, may deploy from Reserve Deck (or lose 1 Force to deploy from Lost Pile) a blaster on Luke (V){{!}}Luke; reshuffle. While armed with a blaster, it may not be stolen and characters hit by Luke may not be used to satisfy attrition. Immune to attrition < 4.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-01-Luke_Skywalker_Rebel_Hero.png]]) prints it. '''Document:''' release-sheet slip; no slip number, the Virtual Block 7 set mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Luke Skywalker, Rebel Hero (Errata)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 7 list and Virtual master list, first archived 21 July 2012 (every capture with game text to 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-1273_26">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock7Type (Virtual Block 7 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “Adds 3 to the power of anything he pilots. When deployed may deploy from Reserve Deck (or lose 1 force to deploy from lost pile) a blaster on Luke (V){{!}}Luke; reshuffle. While armed with a blaster, it may not be stolen and characters hit by Luke may not be used to satisfy attrition. Immune to attrition < 4.” '''What changed:''' Three changes: the comma after “When deployed” is dropped (“When deployed, may” becomes “When deployed may”), “lose 1 Force” is written “lose 1 force”, and “from Lost Pile” is written “from lost pile”, in small letters. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes. '''Document:''' a text list on the website, with no card image.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Luke Skywalker, Rebel Hero (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-lukeskywalkerrebelhero-pre.gif]]): “Adds 3 to the power of anything he pilots. When deployed, may deploy from Reserve Deck (or lose 1 Force to deploy from Lost Pile) a blaster on Luke (V){{!}}Luke; reshuffle. While armed with a blaster, it may not be stolen and characters hit by Luke may not be used to satisfy attrition. Immune to attrition < 4.” '''What changed:''' the card-list changes are undone: the image prints the original words of [[Luke Skywalker, Rebel Hero]] again, character for character. It is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). '''Date:''' placed at its server upload date, 25 February 2013, when the Players Committee server received the Virtual Block 1–7 card images. The image may have been made earlier (Players Committee card images go back to the first Legacy releases), but nothing firmer dates it, so it is placed at the upload date (Bill, 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date; what was published last counts as current). '''Document:''' Players Committee card image; no slip number, as on the release-sheet slip, the Virtual Block 7 set mark, the whole card with the Decipher art.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Luke Skywalker, Rebel Hero (Errata 3)]]): Master List (Light Side p. 11), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=11 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Adds 3 to the power of anything he pilots. When deployed, may deploy from Reserve Deck (or lose 1 Force to deploy from Lost Pile) a blaster on Luke (V){{!}}Luke; reshuffle. While armed with a blaster, it may not be stolen and characters hit by Luke may not be used to satisfy attrition. Immune to attrition < 4.” The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1273-26-master.png]]) prints it. '''What changed:''' nothing against PC-E2; the Master List also prints the original words of [[Luke Skywalker, Rebel Hero]] again, character for character. It is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). '''Document:''' Master List slip; no slip number, as on the release-sheet slip, the Virtual Block 7 set mark.
